---
title: "Figure 4 — Rim15-dependent phosphorylation during quiescence entry"
author: "Sun et al."
output: html_document
---

**Purpose:** Self-contained reproduction of all R-generated panels in Figure 4.
Extracted and reorganized from `05_psites_analysis.Rmd`.

**Inputs (pre-generated by pipeline):**
- `tables/normed_pSite_ratio_perseus.csv` — normalized phosphosite SILAC ratios (from `05_psites_analysis.Rmd`)
- `tables/DE_pSites_byGenotype.csv` — differential phosphorylation results (from `05_psites_analysis.Rmd`)
- `tables/ancova_pSites_genotype_sig.csv` — ANCOVA genotype effect, q < 0.1 (from `05_psites_analysis.Rmd`; used for Panel D UpSet)
- `data/Phospho (STY)Sites.csv` — MaxQuant phosphosite table (sequence windows)

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("figure4/Figure4.Rmd")`

**Panel G note:** Protein-protein interaction network was constructed using interaction
scores from the STRING database (see Panel G chunk below) and visualized in Cytoscape.
The edge list is provided as source data (`figure4/source_data/Fig4G_source_data.csv`).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)
library(ggrepel)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(rmotifx)      # motifx (devtools::install_github("omarwagih/rmotifx"))
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)
library(DOSE)
library(cowplot)

out_dir  <- "figure4/plots"
data_dir <- "figure4/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
# Pre-generated tables from 05_psites_analysis.Rmd
pSite_perseus <- read_csv("./tables/normed_pSite_ratio_perseus.csv",
                          show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c("id")) %>%
  drop_na(Proteins)
pSite_perseus[is.na(pSite_perseus)] <- 0

logFC_ttest_pS <- read_csv("./tables/DE_pSites_byGenotype.csv",
                           show_col_types = FALSE)

# ANCOVA genotype effect (q < 0.1) — used for Panel D UpSet plot
ancova_pS <- read_csv("./tables/ancova_pSites_genotype_sig.csv",
                      show_col_types = FALSE)

# Raw MaxQuant phosphosite table — needed for sequence windows (Panel C)
Sys.setenv("VROOM_CONNECTION_SIZE" = 131072 * 10)
phosphosites <- read_csv("./data/Phospho (STY)Sites.csv",
                         show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r derived-data}
# Tidy pSite ratios (genotype × nutrient × time × replicate)
pSite_tidy <- melt(pSite_perseus) %>%
  separate(variable, c("genotype", "nutrient", "samplingTime", "replicate"),
           sep = "_") %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype %in% c("rim15KO", "WT"))

# Relative phosphorylation (each site normalised to its own T00 value)
relative_pS <- pSite_tidy %>%
  unite(cond, genotype, nutrient, replicate) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  spread(key = samplingTime, value = value) %>%
  mutate(`T00/T00` = T00 / T00,
         `T06/T00` = T06 / T00,
         `T16/T00` = T16 / T00,
         `T30/T00` = T30 / T00) %>%
  melt() %>%
  separate(cond, c("genotype", "nutrient", "replicate"), sep = "_")

# Sequence windows for motif analysis
ratio_sequence <- phosphosites %>%
  dplyr::select(Proteins, id, `Positions within proteins`, `Leading proteins`,
                `Protein names`, `Gene names`, `Fasta headers`,
                `Localization prob`, `Sequence window`) %>%
  dplyr::select(-matches("_N_")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-matches("___")) %>%
  mutate(id = factor(id)) %>%
  unite(pSite, `Gene names`, `Positions within proteins`, remove = FALSE) %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Localization prob` > 0.7) %>%
  dplyr::select(-c(`Localization prob`, `Positions within proteins`)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("variability")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("count")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("iso-count")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains("type"))

n <- 9; m <- 23   # width = m-n+1 = 15 (must be odd for motifx); phosphosite at position 16 of MaxQuant 31-char window → position 8 of extracted motif
ratio_sequence$motif <- substr(ratio_sequence$`Sequence window`, n, m)
ratio_sequence$shortmotif <- substr(ratio_sequence$`Sequence window`, 16, 17)
ratio_sequence_motif <- dplyr::filter(
  ratio_sequence,
  substring(ratio_sequence$motif, m - n + 1, m - n + 1) != "_")
```

## Panel A — Volcano: Rim15-dependent phosphorylation at T=16 h (quiescence entry), phosphorus condition

**Note:** The published figure shows the T=16 h timepoint in the phosphorus starvation
condition. The figure legend text "T=0 hours" was an error in the legend; the original
analysis script (`05_psites_analysis.Rmd`, saved in `rescue/drive-versions/`) uses
`time == "T16"`. Labelled sites: IGO1_64 (canonical Rim15 target), TPS2_890, HEK2_252.

**Important:** `tables/DE_pSites_byGenotype.csv` must be regenerated by running
`05_psites_analysis.Rmd` after the log2FC formula correction (division, not subtraction)
for these labels to appear at their correct positions.

```{r panel-A}
# Labelled sites per published figure
label_sites <- c("IGO1_64", "TPS2_890", "HEK2_252")

show_label <- logFC_ttest_pS %>%
  dplyr::filter(pSite %in% label_sites, nutrient == "P", time == "T16")

# ---- Panel A plot ----
p_A <- ggplot(data = logFC_ttest_pS %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient == "P", time == "T16"),
              aes(x = log2FC, y = -log10(qvalue))) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(logFC_ttest_pS,
                                  nutrient == "P", time == "T16",
                                  qvalue > 0.05),
             alpha = 1 / 6, size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(logFC_ttest_pS,
                                  nutrient == "P", time == "T16",
                                  log2FC < 0, qvalue <= 0.051),
             alpha = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#00afbb") +
  geom_point(data = dplyr::filter(logFC_ttest_pS,
                                  nutrient == "P", time == "T16",
                                  log2FC > 0, qvalue <= 0.051),
             alpha = 1, size = 2.5, color = "#e7b800") +
  geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(show_label, log2FC < 0, qvalue <= 0.051),
                  aes(label = pSite), size = 3,
                  hjust = 1, nudge_x = 0.05, direction = "y", segment.size = 0.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = dplyr::filter(show_label, log2FC > 0, qvalue <= 0.051),
                  aes(label = pSite), size = 3,
                  hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.5, direction = "y", segment.size = 0.5) +
  xlab(expression(Log[2] * " (WT / rim15Δ)")) +
  ylab(expression(-Log[10] * "(q-value)")) +
  ylim(0, 2) +
  facet_grid(nutrient ~ time) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

p_A
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Fig4A_volcano_T16_P.pdf"),
       p_A, width = 5, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)

# Source data export
Fig4A_source <- logFC_ttest_pS %>%
  dplyr::filter(nutrient == "P", time == "T16") %>%
  dplyr::select(pSite, `Gene names`, `Protein names`,
                nutrient, time, log2FC, pvalue, qvalue) %>%
  arrange(qvalue)

write_csv(Fig4A_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig4A_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig4A: ", nrow(Fig4A_source), " phosphosites exported")
```

## Panel B — IGO1_64 phosphorylation dynamics over time (C and P, WT vs rim15Δ)

```{r panel-B}
# Use absolute normalized phosphorylation (phospho/protein) from pSite_tidy directly.
# C condition replicate R2 is a reciprocal SILAC labeling (WT and rim15KO labels swapped)
# and is excluded to avoid confounding the mean.
igo1_64 <- pSite_tidy %>%
  dplyr::filter(pSite == "IGO1_64",
                samplingTime %in% c("T00", "T06", "T16", "T30"),
                genotype %in% c("WT", "rim15KO"),
                !(nutrient == "C" & replicate == "R2")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(time = samplingTime)

# Summarise mean ± SD per genotype × nutrient × time
igo1_summary <- igo1_64 %>%
  group_by(genotype, nutrient, time) %>%
  summarise(mean_rel = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_rel   = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups  = "drop") %>%
  mutate(time = factor(time, levels = c("T00", "T06", "T16", "T30")),
         genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("WT", "rim15KO")))

nutrient_labels <- c("C" = "Carbon starvation", "P" = "Phosphorus starvation")
genotype_colors <- c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB")

p_B <- ggplot(igo1_summary,
              aes(x = time, y = mean_rel,
                  group = genotype, color = genotype, fill = genotype)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_rel - sd_rel,
                  ymax = mean_rel + sd_rel), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~ nutrient, labeller = as_labeller(nutrient_labels)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = genotype_colors,
                     labels = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = genotype_colors,
                    labels  = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
  xlab("Hours post nutrient depletion") +
  ylab("Normalized phosphorylation\n(phospho/protein)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.title     = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold")) +
  ggtitle("IGO1 S64 phosphorylation dynamics")

p_B
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Fig4B_IGO1_S64_dynamics.pdf"),
       p_B, width = 8, height = 4, useDingbats = FALSE)

# Source data export (replicate-level values)
Fig4B_source <- igo1_64 %>%
  dplyr::select(pSite, genotype, nutrient, time, replicate, value) %>%
  dplyr::rename(normalized_phosphorylation = value) %>%
  arrange(nutrient, genotype, time, replicate)

write_csv(Fig4B_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig4B_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig4B: ", nrow(Fig4B_source), " rows exported")
```

## Panel C — Phosphorylation motif enrichment (C and P starvation)

Motif logos in the published figure were rendered in **iceLogo** (external tool) using
the sequence windows exported here. The `rmotifx` calls below identify significantly
enriched motifs; `motif_sig*.csv` tables feed directly into iceLogo.

```{r panel-C}
sig_logFC_all <- right_join(
  ratio_sequence,
  logFC_ttest_pS %>% dplyr::filter(log2FC > 1, qvalue < 0.05),
  by = c("pSite", "Proteins", "Leading proteins",
         "Protein names", "Gene names", "Fasta headers")) %>%
  drop_na()

sig_logFC_all$motif      <- substr(sig_logFC_all$`Sequence window`, n, m)
sig_logFC_all$shortmotif <- substr(sig_logFC_all$`Sequence window`, 16, 17)

sig_motif_all <- dplyr::filter(
  sig_logFC_all,
  substring(sig_logFC_all$motif, m - n + 1, m - n + 1) != "_")

# Motif enrichment per nutrient condition
fg_P <- sig_motif_all %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient == "P")
fg_C <- sig_motif_all %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient == "C")

motif_P <- tryCatch(
  motifx(fg_P$motif, ratio_sequence_motif$motif,
         central.res = "S", min.seqs = 10, pval.cutoff = 0.05,
         verbose = FALSE, perl.impl = FALSE),
  error = function(e) { message("motifx P: ", e$message); NULL })

motif_C <- tryCatch(
  motifx(fg_C$motif, ratio_sequence_motif$motif,
         central.res = "S", min.seqs = 10, pval.cutoff = 0.05,
         verbose = FALSE, perl.impl = FALSE),
  error = function(e) { message("motifx C: ", e$message); NULL })

print("Phosphorus starvation motifs:"); print(motif_P)
print("Carbon starvation motifs:");     print(motif_C)

# Source data: sequence windows for iceLogo rendering
# iceLogo inputs: foreground = significant sites; background = all detected sites
# Note: Panel C logos were rendered in iceLogo v3 using these tables.
Fig4C_source_P <- fg_P %>%
  dplyr::select(pSite, `Gene names`, `Fasta headers`,
                `Sequence window`, motif, shortmotif, nutrient, log2FC, qvalue) %>%
  mutate(SQ_TQ = ifelse(shortmotif %in% c("SQ", "TQ"), "S/TQ", "Other"))

Fig4C_source_C <- fg_C %>%
  dplyr::select(pSite, `Gene names`, `Fasta headers`,
                `Sequence window`, motif, shortmotif, nutrient, log2FC, qvalue) %>%
  mutate(SQ_TQ = ifelse(shortmotif %in% c("SQ", "TQ"), "S/TQ", "Other"))

Fig4C_source <- bind_rows(Fig4C_source_P, Fig4C_source_C)

write_csv(Fig4C_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig4C_source_data.csv"))
# Also export background (all detected sites with motif windows)
write_csv(ratio_sequence_motif %>%
            dplyr::select(pSite, `Gene names`, `Sequence window`, motif),
          file.path(data_dir, "Fig4C_background_all_psites.csv"))
message("Fig4C: ", nrow(Fig4C_source), " foreground sites exported")
```

## Panel D — UpSet plot: Rim15-dependent phosphosites unique to and shared between C and P starvation

Each pSite is classified by direction (estimate > 0 = higher in WT) and condition.
Source: ANCOVA genotype effect, q < 0.1 (`tables/ancova_pSites_genotype_sig.csv`).
Four sets: WT↑ in C, WT↑ in P, rim15Δ↑ in C, rim15Δ↑ in P.

```{r panel-D}
library(UpSetR)

# Unique pSites per direction × condition (ANCOVA, q < 0.1)
wt_C   <- ancova_pS %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient=="C", estimate>0) %>% pull(pSite) %>% unique()
wt_P   <- ancova_pS %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient=="P", estimate>0) %>% pull(pSite) %>% unique()
rim_C  <- ancova_pS %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient=="C", estimate<0) %>% pull(pSite) %>% unique()
rim_P  <- ancova_pS %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient=="P", estimate<0) %>% pull(pSite) %>% unique()

cat("WT↑ C:", length(wt_C), "  WT↑ P:", length(wt_P),
    "  rim15Δ↑ C:", length(rim_C), "  rim15Δ↑ P:", length(rim_P), "\n")
cat("WT↑ in both C and P:", length(intersect(wt_C, wt_P)), "\n")
cat("rim15Δ↑ in both C and P:", length(intersect(rim_C, rim_P)), "\n")

# Binary membership matrix for UpSetR
all_sites <- unique(c(wt_C, wt_P, rim_C, rim_P))
upset_df <- data.frame(
  pSite       = all_sites,
  `WT_C`      = as.integer(all_sites %in% wt_C),
  `WT_P`      = as.integer(all_sites %in% wt_P),
  `rim15KO_C` = as.integer(all_sites %in% rim_C),
  `rim15KO_P` = as.integer(all_sites %in% rim_P),
  check.names = FALSE)

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Fig4D_upset_pSites.pdf"), width = 7, height = 4)
upset(upset_df,
      sets        = c("WT_C", "WT_P", "rim15KO_C", "rim15KO_P"),
      sets.bar.color = c("#e7b800", "#e7b800", "#00afbb", "#00afbb"),
      order.by    = "freq",
      keep.order  = FALSE,
      text.scale  = 1.2,
      mainbar.y.label = "Phosphosites (q < 0.05)",
      sets.x.label    = "Set size")
dev.off()

upset(upset_df,
      sets        = c("WT_C", "WT_P", "rim15KO_C", "rim15KO_P"),
      sets.bar.color = c("#e7b800", "#e7b800", "#00afbb", "#00afbb"),
      order.by    = "freq",
      keep.order  = FALSE,
      text.scale  = 1.2,
      mainbar.y.label = "Phosphosites (q < 0.05)",
      sets.x.label    = "Set size")

# Source data export
Fig4D_source <- upset_df %>%
  arrange(pSite)

write_csv(Fig4D_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig4D_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig4D: ", nrow(Fig4D_source), " pSites exported; WT-both=",
        length(intersect(wt_C, wt_P)), ", rim15-both=", length(intersect(rim_C, rim_P)))
```

## Panel E — GSEA: enrichment for translation-related terms (C=green, P=purple)

```{r panel-E, cache=TRUE}
# Prep gene list for GSEA: sorted by log2FC, named by gene symbol
sig_ttest_pS_P <- right_join(
  ratio_sequence,
  logFC_ttest_pS %>% dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.05),
  by = c("pSite", "Proteins", "Leading proteins",
         "Protein names", "Gene names", "Fasta headers")) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::filter(nutrient == "P")

# Deduplicate: keep one entry per gene (largest |log2FC|); fgsea requires unique names
sig_ttest_pS_P <- sig_ttest_pS_P %>%
  group_by(`Gene names`) %>%
  slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
gene_list_P <- sig_ttest_pS_P$log2FC
names(gene_list_P) <- sig_ttest_pS_P$`Gene names`
gene_list_P <- sort(na.omit(gene_list_P), decreasing = TRUE)

set.seed(42)
gse_P <- tryCatch(
  gseGO(geneList      = gene_list_P,
        ont           = "ALL",
        keyType       = "GENENAME",
        nPerm         = 1000,
        minGSSize     = 3,
        maxGSSize     = 50,
        pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
        verbose       = FALSE,
        OrgDb         = "org.Sc.sgd.db",
        pAdjustMethod = "none"),
  error = function(e) { message("gseGO P: ", e$message); NULL })

# Repeat for C condition
sig_ttest_pS_C <- right_join(
  ratio_sequence,
  logFC_ttest_pS %>% dplyr::filter(qvalue < 0.05),
  by = c("pSite", "Proteins", "Leading proteins",
         "Protein names", "Gene names", "Fasta headers")) %>%
  drop_na() %>%
  dplyr::filter(nutrient == "C")

# Deduplicate: keep one entry per gene (largest |log2FC|); fgsea requires unique names
sig_ttest_pS_C <- sig_ttest_pS_C %>%
  group_by(`Gene names`) %>%
  slice_max(abs(log2FC), n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()
gene_list_C <- sig_ttest_pS_C$log2FC
names(gene_list_C) <- sig_ttest_pS_C$`Gene names`
gene_list_C <- sort(na.omit(gene_list_C), decreasing = TRUE)

gse_C <- tryCatch(
  gseGO(geneList      = gene_list_C,
        ont           = "ALL",
        keyType       = "GENENAME",
        nPerm         = 1000,
        minGSSize     = 3,
        maxGSSize     = 50,
        pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
        verbose       = FALSE,
        OrgDb         = "org.Sc.sgd.db",
        pAdjustMethod = "none"),
  error = function(e) { message("gseGO C: ", e$message); NULL })

# Individual dotplots (faceted internally by GSEA sign)
if (!is.null(gse_P) && nrow(gse_P@result) > 0) {
  p_E_P <- dotplot(gse_P, showCategory = 20, split = ".sign") +
    facet_grid(. ~ .sign) +
    ggtitle("GSEA — P starvation") +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#8300ab", high = "#c478e8")
  print(p_E_P)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Fig4E_GSEA_P.pdf"),
         p_E_P, width = 10, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
} else {
  message("Fig4E: gseGO P returned no significant terms")
}

if (!is.null(gse_C) && nrow(gse_C@result) > 0) {
  p_E_C <- dotplot(gse_C, showCategory = 20, split = ".sign") +
    facet_grid(. ~ .sign) +
    ggtitle("GSEA — C starvation") +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "#006400", high = "#66c266")
  print(p_E_C)
  ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Fig4E_GSEA_C.pdf"),
         p_E_C, width = 10, height = 6, useDingbats = FALSE)
} else {
  message("Fig4E: gseGO C returned no significant terms")
}

# Source data export
gse_rows <- bind_rows(
  if (!is.null(gse_P)) as.data.frame(gse_P@result) %>% mutate(nutrient = "P"),
  if (!is.null(gse_C)) as.data.frame(gse_C@result) %>% mutate(nutrient = "C"))

Fig4E_source <- gse_rows %>%
  dplyr::select(nutrient, ID, Description, NES, pvalue, p.adjust, setSize,
                any_of("enrichmentScore")) %>%
  arrange(nutrient, pvalue)

write_csv(Fig4E_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig4E_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig4E: ", nrow(Fig4E_source), " GSEA terms exported")
```

## Panel F — Heatmap of 10 common Rim15-dependent phosphosites (log2 WT/rim15Δ, per replicate)

The 10 "common" sites are the top 10 (by minimum q-value) among those with ANCOVA
genotype effect significant in **both** C and P starvation (q < 0.1).
Values are log2(WT/rim15Δ) per individual replicate from normalized phosphorylation data.
C condition replicate R2 is excluded (reciprocal SILAC labeling, labels swapped).

```{r panel-F}
# Identify common sites: significant in both C and P in ANCOVA (q < 0.1)
c_ancova <- ancova_pS %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient == "C") %>% pull(pSite) %>% unique()
p_ancova <- ancova_pS %>% dplyr::filter(nutrient == "P") %>% pull(pSite) %>% unique()
common_all <- intersect(c_ancova, p_ancova)

# Rank by minimum q-value across both conditions; keep top 10
common_10 <- ancova_pS %>%
  dplyr::filter(pSite %in% common_all) %>%
  group_by(pSite) %>%
  summarise(min_q = min(qvalue, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(min_q) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:10) %>%
  pull(pSite)

cat("Common Rim15-dependent phosphosites (n =", length(common_10), "):\n")
print(common_10)

# Per-replicate log2(WT/rim15KO) from pSite_tidy
# Exclude C R2 (reciprocal SILAC: labels swapped, ratio would be inverted)
rep_ratio <- pSite_tidy %>%
  dplyr::filter(pSite %in% common_10,
                samplingTime %in% c("T00", "T06", "T16", "T30"),
                genotype %in% c("WT", "rim15KO"),
                !(nutrient == "C" & replicate == "R2")) %>%
  dplyr::select(pSite, nutrient, samplingTime, replicate, genotype, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = genotype, values_from = value) %>%
  mutate(log2FC = log2(WT / rim15KO)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(is.finite(log2FC)) %>%
  mutate(col_key = paste(nutrient, samplingTime, replicate, sep = "_"))

heatmap_mat <- rep_ratio %>%
  dplyr::select(pSite, col_key, log2FC) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col_key, values_from = log2FC) %>%
  column_to_rownames("pSite")

# Order columns: C first (T00→T30, R1 R3), then P (T00→T30, R1 R2 R3)
col_order <- c(
  outer(c("T00","T06","T16","T30"), c("R1","R3"), paste, sep="_") |> paste0("C_", x = _),
  outer(c("T00","T06","T16","T30"), c("R1","R2","R3"), paste, sep="_") |> paste0("P_", x = _))
col_order <- col_order[col_order %in% colnames(heatmap_mat)]
# fallback if pipe syntax unavailable
if (length(col_order) == 0) {
  col_order <- c(
    paste0("C_", apply(expand.grid(c("T00","T06","T16","T30"),c("R1","R3")), 1, paste, collapse="_")),
    paste0("P_", apply(expand.grid(c("T00","T06","T16","T30"),c("R1","R2","R3")), 1, paste, collapse="_")))
  col_order <- col_order[col_order %in% colnames(heatmap_mat)]
}
heatmap_mat <- heatmap_mat[, col_order]

# Column annotation
ann_col <- data.frame(
  nutrient  = sub("_T.*", "", colnames(heatmap_mat)),
  time      = sub("^[CP]_(T\\d+)_.*", "\\1", colnames(heatmap_mat)),
  replicate = sub(".*_(R\\d+)$", "\\1", colnames(heatmap_mat)),
  row.names = colnames(heatmap_mat))

ann_colors <- list(
  nutrient  = c("C" = "#ff9500", "P" = "#8300ab"),
  time      = c("T00" = "#fee8d0", "T06" = "#fdad60",
                "T16" = "#e85d04", "T30" = "#7f1900"),
  replicate = c("R1" = "#bae6c8", "R2" = "#44c76d", "R3" = "#016320"))

breaksList <- seq(-3, 3, length.out = 101)

p_F <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_mat,
  colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "RdBu")))(100),
  cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_col  = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  breaks   = breaksList,
  main     = "10 common Rim15-dependent phosphosites\nlog2(WT/rim15Δ) per replicate",
  fontsize = 10, fontsize_row = 9, fontsize_col = 7,
  na_col   = "lightgrey",
  silent   = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Fig4F_common10_heatmap.pdf"), width = 10, height = 5)
grid::grid.draw(p_F$gtable)
dev.off()
grid::grid.draw(p_F$gtable)

# Source data export
Fig4F_source <- rep_ratio %>%
  dplyr::select(pSite, nutrient, samplingTime, replicate, log2FC) %>%
  arrange(pSite, nutrient, samplingTime, replicate)

write_csv(Fig4F_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig4F_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig4F: ", length(common_10), " pSites × ", ncol(heatmap_mat), " columns")
```

## Panel G — STRING protein-protein interaction network (10 common Rim15 targets)

The final network layout was produced in **Cytoscape** using the edge list exported here.
Run `install.packages("STRINGdb")` if the package is not available.

```{r panel-G}
# Proteins corresponding to the 10 common Rim15-dependent phosphosites
# (gene symbols extracted from the common_10 pSite keys)
common_10_genes <- unique(sub("_\\d+$", "", common_10))
cat("Proteins to query in STRING:", paste(common_10_genes, collapse = ", "), "\n")

Fig4G_source <- tryCatch({
  library(STRINGdb)
  string_db <- STRINGdb$new(version      = "11.5",
                             species      = 4932,   # S. cerevisiae
                             score_threshold = 400,
                             input_directory = tempdir())

  # Map gene symbols to STRING identifiers
  gene_df <- data.frame(gene = common_10_genes)
  mapped  <- string_db$map(gene_df, "gene", removeUnmappedRows = TRUE)

  # Retrieve interactions between these proteins
  edges   <- string_db$get_interactions(mapped$STRING_id)

  if (nrow(edges) == 0) {
    message("No STRING interactions found above threshold 400.")
    NULL
  } else {
    # Reverse-map STRING IDs to gene names
    id_to_gene <- setNames(mapped$gene, mapped$STRING_id)
    edges_named <- edges %>%
      transmute(
        protein1 = coalesce(id_to_gene[from], from),
        protein2 = coalesce(id_to_gene[to],   to),
        combined_score = combined_score)
    edges_named
  }
}, error = function(e) {
  message("STRINGdb query failed: ", e$message,
          "\nInstall with: install.packages('STRINGdb')")
  # Return a stub with the protein list so the file always exists
  data.frame(protein1 = common_10_genes[1],
             protein2 = common_10_genes[2],
             combined_score = NA_real_,
             note = "STRINGdb not available; query manually at string-db.org")
})

# Network layout was produced in Cytoscape using the edge list above.
# STRINGdb v11.5, Cytoscape v[X.Y.Z].
write_csv(Fig4G_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig4G_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig4G: edge list saved (", nrow(Fig4G_source), " interactions)")
```
